{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
sales = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Parse revenue: remove commas and cast to float
sales['revenue'] = sales['revenue'].str.replace(',', '').astype(float)

# Filter for completed orders
completed_orders = sales[sales['status'] == 'completed']

# Identify QA orders (revenue == 999999.99)
qa_mask = sales['revenue'] == 999999.99
num_qa = qa_mask.sum()

# Remove QA orders from completed set
completed_orders_clean = completed_orders[~qa_mask]

# Confirm the count of completed orders after cleaning
num_completed_clean = len(completed_orders_clean)

# Compute mean revenue on clean data
mean_revenue_clean = completed_orders_clean['revenue'].mean()

print(f"Number of QA orders found: {num_qa}")
print(f"Number of completed orders after removing QA orders: {num_completed_clean}")
print(f"Mean revenue of completed orders (cleaned): {mean_revenue_clean:.2f}")"}
